name: Bowl
summary: This bowl is made of porcelain and is painted with cobalt blue under the glaze with a scene of boys playing in a garden. Boys were a common theme on Ming and Qing porcelains symbolising the desire for many sons and general familial prosperity. It is thought to have been made in the Ming period (1366
